description: From the valley road, the tourist faces Montefalco crowning its ridge center-frame, the compact stone town with its church towers above a sea of rooftops. Silvery olive groves fill the left foreground and ordered vineyard rows climb the right slope, with hazy blue hills on the horizon. The 12:27 sun is bright under a partly cloudy sky, and the hill town glows pale gold above the green patchwork.
